svg.title: AgentFlow end-to-end request lifecycle
svg.desc: Current request sequence from start to two human approval pauses, checkpoint resume and draft pull request publication. Kong is planned and bypassed by current requests. WorkflowService is grouped with FastAPI; WorkflowRunner is grouped with its Celery worker process.
svg.text: One run_id. Several short HTTP requests. Durable background execution.
Current HTTP calls bypass Kong. The planned gateway forwards the same endpoints.
HTTP returns without waiting for the agents. The worker may already be running.
thread_id = run_id. Fetch Jira → prepare workspace → plan → validate.
Checkpoint graph state; tracked nodes write events
This task finishes; the Celery worker stays available. The paused state is in PostgreSQL.
Check run exists and is waiting
A compatible worker resumes the same run; it must also be able to access the workspace.
If approved: branch → implementation → validate/apply patch → Docker tests → review.
Bounded repair routes may retry. Checkpoints and node events continue throughout.
Check run exists and is waiting
After the final approval: commit → push → draft PR → Jira comment → workspace cleanup.
COMPLETED only if PR + Jira update + cleanup succeeded
Exceptions are recorded as FAILED; rejection and incomplete graph exits are not completion.
GET reads PostgreSQL; it never invokes LangGraph. Redis carries tasks, not the durable graph state.
